```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
options(scipen = 999)

county_data <- readxl::read_xlsx(file_path) |> 
  janitor::clean_names()

#connect to data warehouse
db <- RPostgreSQL::dbConnect(RPostgreSQL::PostgreSQL(),
                 dbname = keyring::key_get("warehouse_name"), 
                 host = keyring::key_get("warehouse_host"), 
                 port = keyring::key_get("warehouse_port"), 
                 user = keyring::key_get("warehouse_user"), 
                 password = keyring::key_get("warehouse_password"))

```

```{sql connection=db, echo = FALSE, output.var = "utility_table"}

SELECT DISTINCT utility_name, mn_utility_id AS utility_id
FROM energy.utility_info 

```

Check for duplicate entries

```{r, echo = FALSE}

dup_check <- county_data |> 
  dplyr::mutate(row_id = paste(utility_id, county_name, as.character(year), sep = "_")) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(row_id) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(count = dplyr::n()) |> 
  dplyr::filter(count > 1)

if(nrow(dup_check) == 0){
  
  print("No duplicates found")
  
} else{
  
  print("The following rows are duplicates")
  
  DT::datatable(dup_check)
  
}
  
```

&nbsp;

These utility county values have fluctuated 20% or more compared to the average over the last 3 years.

```{sql connection=db, echo = FALSE, output.var = "county_avg"}
WITH years_use AS(
  SELECT DISTINCT report_year
  FROM energy.county_sales
  ORDER BY report_year DESC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(utility_id, 'FM9999') AS utility_id, county_name, AVG(mwh_delivered) AS mwh_avg
FROM energy.county_sales
WHERE report_year IN (SELECT report_year FROM years_use)
GROUP BY utility, utility_id, county_name
ORDER BY utility


```

```{r, echo = FALSE}

mwh_check <- county_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(mwh_delivered != 0 & is.na(mwh_delivered) == FALSE) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(county_name = dplyr::case_when(
    county_name == "St. Louis" ~ "Saint Louis", 
    TRUE ~ county_name
  )) |> 
  dplyr::left_join(county_avg, by = c("utility_id" = "utility_id", "county_name" = "county_name")) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(percent_diff = (mwh_delivered / mwh_avg) - 1) |> 
  dplyr::filter(abs(percent_diff) >= .2)

DT::datatable(mwh_check)

```
